no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for PIFELTRO™ (doravirine) was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues that were unexpected for doravirine's drug class and there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for the PIFELTRO (doravirine) NDA210806 application. The approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it did not raise unexpected safety or efficacy issues for the drug class and posed no controversial issues warranting AC discussion. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
